extends: existing validated replay convention ?race=&frame= (useReplay.readInitialUrl) + optional driver

parse_rules.frame: required, all-digits non-negative integer; anything else MALFORMED_URL, never coerced/snapped

ownership_direction: URL initializes workspace state exactly once on mount (client-only effect; SSR renders idle null so hydration matches); thereafter workspace transitions update the URL through one path (push for SET_RACE, replace otherwise); URL is never re-read after init
reload: deep link survives reload: hydrateFromUrl is deterministic and stateless; same query resolves to same state (tested); empty query = idle, not error; malformed query = recorded initError, never crash

history.SEEK_FRAME: replace (transient progression; playback never grows history)

loop_guard: sync effect compares serialized state against live URL and no-ops when equal
